scenes.caption: The CRM keeps a small team's companies, people and actions in one place.

card.title: The CRM, and its demo
card.sub: One place for every company, every person and every action the team takes with them, so nobody falls through the gaps.
card.foot: Everything in this video is the demo: every company, person and email is made up.

scenes.caption: It runs in your browser, and opens in demo mode. This banner says every company, person and email here is made up.
The top right always says which vault is open. Here: Vault: Demo. Nothing you do in the demo is saved anywhere.
Today opens on how many companies sit at each stage, from New to Won and Parked.
Then what to do now. Overdue comes first: here, a next step that was due on 21 November.
Next, follow-ups: we wrote and have had no reply for 5 days or more.
Each card has its action. Log the follow-up records what you did next.
The lead board: one row per company, with its stage, owner, draft, last contact and next step.
Follow-ups: everyone we reached out to who has not replied in 5 days or more. Check it every day.
Contacts: everyone, with their company and when we were last in touch. Demo emails use reserved example domains.
Open a company to see its stage, owner, next step, people and every action logged with them.
That is the demo. Next: logging in and opening a vault.

card.title: Next
card.sub: Log in, get a vault through the QR key hand-over, and log every action. Your real contacts live in an encrypted vault that only people with its key can open; the site never sees them.
